# konnect_event_gateway_produce_policy_transcode (Resource)

EventGatewayProducePolicyTranscode Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_event_gateway_produce_policy_transcode" "my_eventgatewayproducepolicytranscode" {
  condition = "record.value.content.foo.bar == \"a-value\""
  config = {
    avro = {
      failure_mode     = "mark"
      on_unknown_field = "fail"
      schema_source = {
        reference = {
          schema_ref_destination = {
            none = {
              # ...
            }
          }
          schema_registry = {
            id = "de460e59-30fd-45da-af2b-292a5823961a"
          }
          subject = "context.topic.name + '-value'"
          version = "'latest'"
        }
      }
    }
  }
  description = ""
  enabled     = true
  gateway_id  = "9524ec7d-36d9-465d-a8c5-83a3c9390458"
  labels = {
    key = "value"
  }
  name               = "...my_name..."
  parent_policy_id   = "1c399fc8-e15c-4021-b66e-7a228d451dd7"
  virtual_cluster_id = "66575524-3680-4571-8e62-88377b472727"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `config` (Attributes) The configuration of the transcode parsed record policy applied to produced records. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `gateway_id` (String) The UUID of your Gateway.
- `parent_policy_id` (String) The unique identifier of the parent schema validation policy. Requires replacement if changed.
- `virtual_cluster_id` (String) The ID of the Virtual Cluster.

### Optional

- `condition` (String) A string containing the boolean expression that determines whether the policy is applied.

When the policy is applied as a child policy of schema_validation, the expression can also reference
`record.value` fields.
Default: ""
- `description` (String) A human-readable description of the policy. Default: ""
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is enabled. Default: true
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels store metadata of an entity that can be used for filtering an entity list or for searching across entity types. 

Keys must be of length 1-63 characters, and cannot start with "kong", "konnect", "mesh", "kic", or "_".
- `name` (String) A unique user-defined name of the policy.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the policy.
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity update date.

<a id="nestedatt--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Optional:

- `avro` (Attributes) The configuration of the transcode parsed record policy when converting produced records to Avro.
Avro requires a schema to serialize the record value, so `schema_source` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--avro))

<a id="nestedatt--config--avro"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.avro`

Required:

- `failure_mode` (String) Describes how to handle a failure in a policy applied to produced records.
* `reject` - rejects the record batch.
* `passthrough` - passes the record silently to the backend cluster even though policy execution failed.
* `mark` - passes the record to the backend cluster but marks it with a `kong/policy-failure-<id>` header whose value is the reason for the policy failure (truncated to 512 characters).

**Requires a minimum runtime version of `1.2`**.
possible known values include one of ["reject", "passthrough", "mark"]
- `schema_source` (Attributes) Determines how to look up the schema to use for the transcoded output data.
Leave this unset if the output data schema isn't needed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--avro--schema_source))

Optional:

- `on_unknown_field` (String) Describes how to handle JSON fields that are not defined in the target schema.
* `fail` - the transcoding fails. The policy `failure_mode` determines how the failure is handled.
* `drop` - the unknown fields are removed from the transcoded value.

**Requires a minimum runtime version of `1.3`**.
possible known values include one of ["fail", "drop"]; Default: "fail"

<a id="nestedatt--config--avro--schema_source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.avro.schema_source`

Optional:

- `inline` (Attributes) A schema embedded directly in the policy configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--avro--schema_source--inline))
- `reference` (Attributes) References a schema registered in a schema registry, computing the subject and version to use. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--avro--schema_source--reference))

<a id="nestedatt--config--avro--schema_source--inline"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.avro.schema_source.inline`

Required:

- `inline` (String) The raw schema text (e.g. an Avro JSON schema) to use for the transcoded output data.


<a id="nestedatt--config--avro--schema_source--reference"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.avro.schema_source.reference`

Required:

- `schema_ref_destination` (Attributes) Defines how to record the schema id for the transcoded output data. See the
[Confluent docs](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/schema-registry/fundamentals/serdes-develop/index.html#wire-format)
for more about the wire format. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--avro--schema_source--reference--schema_ref_destination))
- `schema_registry` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--avro--schema_source--reference--schema_registry))
- `subject` (String) An expression that computes the schema registry subject of the output data's schema.
- `version` (String) An expression that computes the schema registry version of the output data's schema.

<a id="nestedatt--config--avro--schema_source--reference--schema_ref_destination"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.avro.schema_source.reference.schema_ref_destination`

Optional:

- `confluent_format` (Attributes) Prefixes the structured data bytes with a reference to the schema. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--avro--schema_source--reference--schema_ref_destination--confluent_format))
- `none` (Attributes) Do not persist the schema anywhere. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--avro--schema_source--reference--schema_ref_destination--none))
- `record_header` (Attributes) Puts the schema reference in a record header. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--avro--schema_source--reference--schema_ref_destination--record_header))

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_event_gateway_produce_policy_transcode.my_konnect_event_gateway_produce_policy_transcode
  id = jsonencode({
    gateway_id         = "9524ec7d-36d9-465d-a8c5-83a3c9390458"
    id                 = "9524ec7d-36d9-465d-a8c5-83a3c9390458"
    virtual_cluster_id = "..."
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_event_gateway_produce_policy_transcode.my_konnect_event_gateway_produce_policy_transcode '{"gateway_id": "9524ec7d-36d9-465d-a8c5-83a3c9390458", "id": "9524ec7d-36d9-465d-a8c5-83a3c9390458", "virtual_cluster_id": "..."}'
```
